title: SISO Foundry resumable public source campaigns

license.reason: The Foundry software is MIT licensed; observed upstream metadata and data-plane assets retain separate rights.

evidence.summary: The MIT source license resolves at the exact release commit.

addressable.reason: The campaign software and GitHub release are pinned to an exact public commit.

archive_downloadable.reason: The code and campaign contracts have a commit-scoped source archive; operational responses remain outside Git.

manifest_resolvable.reason: The ten-family campaign is a public machine-readable query contract with explicit rights and stop policies.

evidence.summary: The campaign defines ten unique query families, capability tags, rights policy, promotion gate, result limit, and stop conditions.

installable.reason: The dependency-free runner and tests execute, but live campaigns depend on operator GitHub authentication, quota, and an external data plane.

evidence.summary: Thirty Python files compiled, three campaign tests passed, dry-run rendered all ten queries, and publication checks passed.

forkable.reason: The campaign definition, runner, tests, and data boundary are public and MIT licensed.

evidence.summary: The public README documents reproducible campaigns and the external run-state boundary.

portable.reason: Campaign definitions and runner are portable, but the existing multi-gigabyte data plane lacks a public snapshot receipt and live GitHub access can be externally throttled.

evidence.summary: The first live attempt stopped before accepting results when GitHub flagged search as spammy; the local checkpoint preserved a safe restart state.
The release makes public source campaigns reproducible while keeping raw responses, checkpoints, candidates, databases, and corpora in the external Foundry data plane.
